comparisons.peer_topic: Capital allocation methodology and ROE performance measures
comparisons.peer_summary: Each Line of Business (LOB) and Corporate is allocated capital considering peer levels and regulatory requirements, while Return on Equity (ROE) is used as a key performance measure with internal targets established.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and JPM disclose capital allocation methodologies and return metrics for 2024. BAC reports a specific return on average allocated capital of 17% driven by net income, while JPM describes the process of allocating capital to LOBs and using ROE as a performance measure without providing the aggregate segment return percentage in the cited text. Both confirm that capital allocation considers peer levels and regulatory requirements. BAC cites 'The return on average allocated capital was 17 percent, down from 21 percent, due to lower net income.' JPM cites 'Each LOB and Corporate is allocated capital by taking into consideration a variety of factors including capital levels of similarly rated peers and applicable regulatory capital requirements.'
